title: Mercedes G500 years to avoid and the best years to buy
description: Shopping for a W463 G500? The year matters more than the mileage. 2002–04 trucks have the electrical gremlins: seat motors, window regulators, lock and transfer-case actuators. 2005–08 is the sweet spot, and the 7-speed 7G-Tronic arrived for the 2007 US model year. Year-by-year guide, recalls and what to check before you buy. Photo: Bahnfrend, CC BY-SA 3.0

title: Land Cruiser 80 Series vs 100 Series: which should you buy?
description: Buy the 80 for solid axles, factory front and rear lockers and the simplest Land Cruiser to fix at home. Buy the 100 for towing, long highway miles and family duty, with V8 power, the five-speed (2003 on) and a quieter cabin. The full head-to-head: specs, what breaks and what they cost now. Photos: Darina Rodionova / Unsplash; Andries Oudshoorn, CC BY-SA 2.0

title: Jeep Wrangler JL vs Ford Bronco: which 4x4 should you buy?
description: For most buyers, the Bronco: its independent front suspension makes it the better daily driver, and factory 35s are available. The Wrangler Rubicon keeps what rock crawlers want, a solid front axle and a 4:1 transfer case, and used two-doors start cheaper. Full comparison with specs and buying advice. Photos: BLM California (public domain); Thomas Tucker / Unsplash

title: Defender vs Grenadier vs G-Class: which new boxy 4x4 to buy
description: The Defender is the best all-rounder and the cheapest used. The Grenadier is the traditional one, with a ladder frame and beam axles. The G-Class puts three lockers and a ladder frame inside a luxury car, at luxury-car prices. The full three-way comparison. Photos: Karsten Winegeart / Unsplash; Calreyn88, CC BY-SA 4.0; Dextar Studio / Pexels
